title: The Wise Men Follow the Star! 🌟 Gold, Frankincense & Myrrh | Bible Story for Kids | Sunday School
desc:
The wise men followed the star to Jesus! 🌟🐫 In this Bible story for kids, the Magi see a brand new star, ride their camels on a long journey, meet grumpy King Herod, and finally find baby Jesus with Saint Mary. They worship Him and give gold, frankincense and myrrh, then go home another way.

📖 Memory verse: "And you will seek Me and find Me, when you search for Me with all your heart." (Jeremiah 29:13)
🎯 Lesson: Hope, trust and patience. We search for Jesus when we pray, read the Bible and go to church, and the best gift we can give Him is our heart.
🙏 Great for Sunday School, Kindergarten and family devotion time.
